_comment: Starter experiment : SHIPS PAUSED ON PURPOSE. Do not run an A/B on your first setup: ship with one template until you have a format you're happy with, then flip status to "live" and let assign_arm.py rotate. The arms below are an EXAMPLE of shape, not a recommendation for your business : rewrite them when you're ready to test. Optional fields per experiment: channel, direction, aggregate : see engine-loop/references/ab-testing.md.

arms.label: answer first
arms.hypothesis: Answering in the first hundred words holds the reader who arrived from a search result.

arms.label: context first
arms.hypothesis: A short concrete situation before the answer builds enough trust to carry the reader further down the page. Costs some bounce, may win on time-on-page and conversion.
